title: Cloud & Deployment
description: Deploy applications to the cloud with AWS, understand core cloud services, infrastructure as code, and modern deployment platforms.

topics.title: Cloud Fundamentals
topics.content:
### The Cloud is Just Someone Else's Computer

That's technically true, but the value is in the operational model: instead of buying servers upfront, you rent compute on-demand, pay for what you use, and scale instantly. Cloud providers handle the physical hardware, power, cooling, and network infrastructure.

#### The Three Service Models

| Model | You manage | Provider manages | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **IaaS** (Infrastructure as a Service) | OS, runtime, app | Physical servers, network | AWS EC2, Google Compute Engine |
| **PaaS** (Platform as a Service) | App code only | OS, runtime, scaling | Heroku, Railway, Render |
| **SaaS** (Software as a Service) | Configuration only | Everything | GitHub, Slack, Datadog |

#### The Three Deployment Models

- **Public Cloud**: Resources shared across customers (AWS, GCP, Azure). Most cost-effective.
- **Private Cloud**: Dedicated hardware for one organisation. Required for regulatory compliance in some industries.
- **Hybrid Cloud**: Mix of on-premises and public cloud. Common during migrations.

#### Core Concepts Every Developer Needs

**Regions and Availability Zones**

AWS has ~32 geographic regions (e.g., `us-east-1`, `eu-west-2`). Each region has 2-6 Availability Zones (AZs) — isolated data centers within the same region. Running across multiple AZs protects you from a single data center failure.

```
Region: us-east-1 (N. Virginia)
├── AZ: us-east-1a  (Data center 1)
├── AZ: us-east-1b  (Data center 2)
└── AZ: us-east-1c  (Data center 3)
```

**Principle of Least Privilege**

Every service, user, and application should have the minimum permissions needed to do its job. This limits the blast radius if credentials are compromised.

topics.title: AWS Core Services
Infrastructure as Code
PaaS Platforms: Railway, Render, Fly.io
topics.content:
### Deploying Without the AWS Complexity

AWS is powerful but complex. For indie developers, startups, and side projects, PaaS platforms (Platform as a Service) handle the infrastructure so you can focus on code.

#### Railway

Railway detects your project type and deploys with minimal config. It can provision databases, set environment variables, and give you a domain — all in minutes.

```yaml
# railway.toml (optional, Railway often auto-detects)
[build]
builder = "nixpacks"
buildCommand = "npm run build"

[deploy]
startCommand = "npm start"
healthcheckPath = "/health"
healthcheckTimeout = 300
restartPolicyType = "on_failure"
restartPolicyMaxRetries = 3
```

```bash
# Install Railway CLI
npm install -g @railway/cli

# Login
railway login

# Link project
railway link

# Deploy
railway up

# Set environment variable
railway variables set JWT_SECRET=your-secret

# View logs
railway logs
```

#### Render

Render offers free-tier web services, databases, and static sites:

```yaml
# render.yaml (Render blueprint)
services:
  - type: web
    name: myapp-api
    env: node
    buildCommand: npm install && npm run build
    startCommand: npm start
    envVars:
      - key: NODE_ENV
        value: production
      - key: DATABASE_URL
        fromDatabase:
          name: myapp-db
          property: connectionString

databases:
  - name: myapp-db
    databaseName: myapp
    user: myapp
```

#### Fly.io

Fly.io runs your Docker containers close to your users (edge deployment):

```toml
# fly.toml
app = 'myapp'
primary_region = 'lhr'   # London

[build]
  dockerfile = 'Dockerfile'

[http_service]
  internal_port = 3000
  force_https = true
  auto_stop_machines = true
  auto_start_machines = true

[[vm]]
  memory = '512mb'
  cpu_kind = 'shared'
  cpus = 1
```

```bash
# Deploy to Fly.io
fly deploy

# Scale to multiple regions
fly scale count 2 --region lhr,iad

# Open a console in your running app
fly ssh console
```

#### Choosing a Platform

| Platform | Best for | Free tier |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Railway** | Fast iteration, full-stack projects | $5/month free credit |
| **Render** | Low-traffic services, static sites | Free web services (spin down) |
| **Fly.io** | Global edge, containers | Generous free tier |
| **Vercel** | Frontend (Next.js) | Free for personal projects |
| **AWS/GCP** | Production at scale | Pay-as-you-go |
